# hubspot_form_definition (Resource)

Manages one narrowly typed HubSpot Form definition by its generated `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_form_definition" "contact" {
  name = "Contact us"

  field_groups = [{
    fields = [{
      label                  = "Email address"
      description            = "Contact email"
      placeholder            = "name@example.com"
      required               = true
      blocked_email_domains  = []
      use_default_block_list = true
    }]
  }]

  configuration = {
    language                         = "en"
    allow_link_to_reset_known_values = false
    pre_populate_known_values        = false
    recaptcha_enabled                = true
    thank_you_text                   = "Thank you"
  }

  display_options = {
    submit_button_text = "Submit"
    style = {
      label_text_size          = "13px"
      label_text_color         = "#33475b"
      legal_consent_text_size  = "12px"
      legal_consent_text_color = "#33475b"
      help_text_size           = "11px"
      help_text_color          = "#516f90"
      font_family              = "Arial, sans-serif"
      background_width         = "100%"
      submit_font_color        = "#ffffff"
      submit_alignment         = "left"
      submit_size              = "12px 24px"
      submit_color             = "#ff7a59"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) Explicit supported form behavior. Automation, notifications, and new-contact creation remain provider-owned and disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `display_options` (Attributes) Explicit safe-rendering presentation options. Raw HTML remains disabled and theme is fixed to `default_style`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_options))
- `field_groups` (Attributes List) Ordered form field groups. Exactly one provider-owned `default_group` is supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_groups))
- `name` (String) Form display name; it is presentation, not identity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) HubSpot-generated form identifier used for exact reads and terminal archival.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `allow_link_to_reset_known_values` (Boolean) Whether visitors may reset pre-filled known values.
- `language` (String) Language code used to render the form.
- `pre_populate_known_values` (Boolean) Whether known contact values are pre-populated.
- `recaptcha_enabled` (Boolean) Whether HubSpot reCAPTCHA protection is enabled.
- `thank_you_text` (String) Text rendered after a successful submission; the action type is fixed to thank_you.


<a id="nestedatt--display_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_options`

Required:

- `style` (Attributes) Explicit visual style values for the safely rendered form. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_options--style))
- `submit_button_text` (String) Visible submit button text.

<a id="nestedatt--display_options--style"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_options.style`

Required:

- `background_width` (String) CSS width for the form background.
- `font_family` (String) CSS font family for form text.
- `help_text_color` (String) CSS color for help text.
- `help_text_size` (String) CSS size for help text.
- `label_text_color` (String) CSS color for field labels.
- `label_text_size` (String) CSS size for field labels.
- `legal_consent_text_color` (String) CSS color for legal consent text, retained even though consent is disabled.
- `legal_consent_text_size` (String) CSS size for legal consent text, retained even though consent is disabled.
- `submit_alignment` (String) Alignment for the submit button.
- `submit_color` (String) CSS color for the submit button.
- `submit_font_color` (String) CSS color for submit button text.
- `submit_size` (String) CSS padding for the submit button.



<a id="nestedatt--field_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_groups`

Required:

- `fields` (Attributes List) Ordered group fields. Exactly one provider-owned contacts `email` field is supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_groups--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--field_groups--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_groups.fields`

Required:

- `blocked_email_domains` (List of String) Explicit ordered email-domain block list; an empty list blocks no additional domains.
- `description` (String) Visible help description for the email field.
- `label` (String) Visible label for the email field.
- `placeholder` (String) Visible placeholder for the email field.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the email field must be completed before submission.
- `use_default_block_list` (Boolean) Whether HubSpot's default email-domain block list is applied.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_form_definition.contact '01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef'
```
